title: Longest Resilient Subarray I
statement: The task is to find the longest subarray of nums (n up to 2500, values and k up to 10^5) such that deleting any one element leaves a sum divisible by k. The key reduction: every element must be congruent to the subarray sum modulo k, so all share one residue r and (length−1)·r ≡ 0 mod k, solved per same-residue run with gcd or by an O(n^2) scan.
